name: Jett Marcello
source:
Coming from a line of world renowned exorcists, Jett follows in his family's footsteps. Like his ancestors, he is a natural born leader known for keep a cool head in some of the most dangerous and terrifying scenarios. 

After his graduation, he plans on joining his family business as one of their top exorcists.

[From the official Character sheet.]
